Why this file exists at all: Vercel applies zero-config framework detection
to any repository, and the presence of a pyproject.toml makes it attempt a
FastAPI build. That build cannot succeed here -- the API is served by
server.py through gunicorn/uvicorn, so there is no module-level ASGI 'app'
Error: Found server.py but it does not define a top-level 'app' FastAPI
Setting "framework": null does NOT prevent this; Vercel still detects the
Python entrypoint and builds. ignoreCommand returning 0 is what actually
skips the build for every commit, which is correct here because this
repository has no Vercel build target to run.
The alternative -- leaving the failing build in place -- puts a permanent
red check on every pull request, which teaches reviewers to ignore red
If a Vercel deployment is ever wanted, remove ignoreCommand and target the
frontend instead: rootDirectory 'frontend', with VITE_API_BASE pointing at
a separately hosted API. The repository root is not a deployable unit.
